scripts.watch:cert: while true; do clear; npm run --silent status:cert; sleep 2; done
scripts.verify: npm run verify:runtime && npm run verify:workspace && npm run verify:submodules
scripts.build: npm -w intrastructure run build && npm -w hson-live run build && npm -w hson-demo2 run build
scripts.precheck: npm --prefix hson-live ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix hson-live/editors/vscode-hson ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.check:deploy-scripts: node --check scripts/static-report.mjs && node --check scripts/build-static.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-static-production-artifact.mjs && node --check scripts/deploy-static.mjs && node --check scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.check:hson-live: npm -w hson-live run check && npm -w hson-live run check:entrypoints
scripts.check:hson-demo2: npm -w hson-demo2 run check && npm -w hson-demo2 run check:cloudflare
scripts.check: npm run check:hson-live && npm run check:deploy-scripts && npm run verify:package-surface && npm run check:hson-demo2
scripts.preflight:worker: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.prepare:node-production: npm run verify && npm -w hson-demo2 run build:node-production && npm run check && npm run preflight:node-production
scripts.verify:demo2: test "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse origin/main)" && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD hson-demo2 | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse HEAD)"
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run preflight:worker && node scripts/preflight-cloudflare.mjs && npm -w hson-demo2 run cloudflare:deploy
